title: Introducing OmniGEC: A Silver Multilingual Dataset for Grammatical Error Correction

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) performance using GLEU scores across 11 different languages to evaluate and mitigate the English-centric performance gap for low- and mid-resource languages.
Conducting human evaluation (grading on a 1-5 scale) and manual error analysis of synthetically generated corrections to identify excessive or unnecessary edits.
